label_source: preregistered sparse-failure invariants plus benign controls

cases.rationale: Task completion consistency completely fails while neighboring v2 observations remain strong.
Verification success completely fails while neighboring v2 observations remain strong.
Rule support completely fails while neighboring v2 observations remain strong.
Evidence validity completely fails while neighboring v2 observations remain strong.
Reasoning instability is maximally degraded while all neighboring penalty observations remain low.
Context decay is maximally degraded while all neighboring penalty observations remain low.
Overconfidence feedback is maximally degraded while neighboring behavioral observations remain low.
Latency pressure is maximally degraded while neighboring operational observations remain low.
Workflow interruption is maximally degraded while neighboring operational observations remain low.
Domain calibration is deliberately low in a bounded synthetic case but is not preregistered as a hard decision-validity prerequisite by itself.
Task completion is deliberately just above the candidate prerequisite threshold to test false alarms under threshold changes.
Evidence validity is deliberately just above the candidate prerequisite threshold to test threshold sensitivity.
Reasoning continuity is borderline but remains above the broader invariant threshold.
A single moderate output-entropy observation is elevated but below the preregistered extreme-degradation threshold.
A single moderate behavioral-entropy observation is elevated but below the preregistered extreme-degradation threshold.
A single moderate operational-entropy observation is elevated but below the preregistered extreme-degradation threshold.
